name: Self Harm
overview: Scripture clearly forbids self-inflicted harm, as seen in Leviticus 19:28 where God commands against making cuttings in the flesh. Yet, the Bible also offers profound comfort to those struggling with brokenness, assuring that the Lord is close to the contrite of heart (Psalms 34:18) and promises strength, help, and support (Isaiah 41:10). God's plans are for peace and hope (Jeremiah 29:11), and through Christ, believers receive abundant life beyond destruction (John 10:10), affirming the value and purpose God places on every life.
